name: Nite Owl West
notes: Drink-only dive bar. Yelp category is 'Dive Bars', no Menu tab/photos in the photo gallery (only Inside/Outside/All). San Diego Reader profile confirms: patrons drink $4.50 well drinks and cheap beer 'while ordering Chinese takeout' — i.e. customers bring in outside food rather than the bar serving its own food menu. No website on file, Facebook/Yelp inaccessible to curl and WebFetch (403), but the Reader description independently establishes there is no in-house food menu to find. not_found per playbook's drink-only dive bar example.
